channel.title: The Pointe at Kirby Gate: Guides & Resources
channel.description: Guides for families comparing assisted living and memory care in East Memphis.

item.title: How to Talk to a Parent About Moving to Assisted Living
item.description: You have probably rehearsed this talk in your head more than once. Maybe it was after a phone call that didn't sound quite right, or after you noticed the mail piling up on the kitchen table.

item.title: Selling a Parent's Home to Pay for Assisted Living
item.description: For many families, the house is the biggest thing a parent owns. It is also full of memories, which is why the question of selling it can sit unspoken for months.

item.title: How Much Does Assisted Living Cost in Memphis? 2027 Guide
item.description: If you are reading this late at night with a calculator open, you are not alone.

item.title: Is Assisted Living or Memory Care Tax Deductible?
item.description: If you are helping pay for a parent's care, or managing the money they use to pay for it, a question tends to surface around this time of year: can any of this be deducted on a tax return?

item.title: VA Aid and Attendance: A Guide for Veteran Families
item.description: Veterans Day has a way of bringing family history to the surface. Maybe it's Dad's old service photo on the mantel, or a conversation with Mom about the years she spent as a Navy nurse.

item.title: Choosing Assisted Living Near East Memphis and Germantown
item.description: When a parent needs more help than home can give, most families start their search the same way: close to where everyone already lives.

item.title: Does Medicare Pay for Assisted Living? What It Covers
item.description: It is one of the first questions families ask when a parent starts needing more help: will Medicare pay for assisted living?

item.title: What Is Respite Care and When Should You Use It?
item.description: If you are caring for a parent, you probably know the feeling: you love them, you want to keep going, and you are running on empty.

item.title: Assisted Living vs. Memory Care: What's the Difference?
item.description: When a parent starts needing more help, two terms come up again and again: assisted living and memory care.

item.title: Holidays and Dementia: Making Visits Meaningful
item.description: The holidays can feel different once a parent is living with dementia.

item.title: 10 Signs It May Be Time for Memory Care
item.description: Few families decide on memory care in a single moment. More often, small changes pile up over months: a missed medication, a pot left on the stove, a phone call at 3 a.m.

item.title: Questions to Ask on an Assisted Living Tour
item.description: A tour is the only part of this decision you can do in person. Here is what to ask, what to notice, and what a good answer sounds like.
